verdict.rationale: n8n documents self-hosting on your own infrastructure, on-premises, or in a private cloud, so data location is set by where you deploy it. A community user corroborates that self-hosting eases client-data restrictions. However, there is no evidence of a region or residency selector for n8n Cloud, nor any explicit data-residency documentation. Missing for 10: documented cloud region/residency choice, explicit data-residency guarantees or docs, independent verification of residency controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
